title: Automate Lead Qualification with Zia Agent Studio #Shorts
description:
Learn how to build a no-code Zia agent in Zoho CRM Agent Studio to automatically score and route incoming leads, saving valuable SDR time.

1. Go to Zia Agent Studio in Zoho CRM and create a new agent with a natural language prompt.
2. Select the trigger rule: when a new lead is created with a score below threshold.
3. Attach one of the 700+ built-in actions to enrich company data and assign to the right rep.

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

#Shorts #Zoho #AIAutomation #ZohoCRM #AIAgents

angle.problem: Repetitive lead qualification eats SDR time before they even know if a lead is worth calling.
angle.solution: Build a no-code Zia agent in Agent Studio that automatically scores and routes new incoming leads.
steps: Go to Zia Agent Studio in Zoho CRM and create a new agent with a natural language prompt.
Select the trigger rule: when a new lead is created with a score below threshold.
Attach one of the 700+ built-in actions to enrich company data and assign to the right rep.
angle.result: SDRs only talk to pre-qualified hot leads, slashing conversion time in half.
angle.wow: You can build a fully autonomous lead qualification agent without writing a single line of code.
